accepted_findings.title: dwelling-root becomes still ruin testimony
accepted_findings.claim: The dwelling noun can carry a bounded stillness image: former habitation is now legible through what has stopped.
accepted_findings.mechanism: مَسَاكِنِهِمْ is a s-k-n place noun, and the destruction setting supplies the contrast between settlement and stillness.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The ruins testify through stopped life, not merely through their former occupants.
accepted_findings.containment: Dwelling remains primary; the stillness facet is a contained root pressure, not a literal gloss of silence.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: F001-F002: movement ends and the settled place remains still
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The peoples have been destroyed while their dwellings remain as evidence
branch_contributions.contribution: The place noun lets former habitation and present stillness overlap.
branch_contributions.boundary: No literal silence, wind, rain, or emotional calm is claimed.

accepted_findings.title: base source governance with variant agency pressure
accepted_findings.claim: The base reading makes the dwellings the governed source of clarity; a nominative variant can be preserved as a secondary agency pressure.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The source preposition governs the plural dwelling noun in the base parse, while the supplied variant changes the evidentiary emphasis without replacing that parse.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel both the ordinary source relation and the stronger alternative in which the remains seem to disclose actively.
accepted_findings.containment: Base genitive syntax controls; the nominative agency reading is a live variant, not a second local parse asserted as primary.

accepted_findings.title: dwellings recur as the surviving witness after destruction
accepted_findings.claim: The dwellings function as remaining readable witnesses after destruction, not merely as scenery.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The plural possessed place noun is connected by the supplied recurrence evidence to surviving-dwelling testimony, and the local ruin frame makes that recurrence active.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader reads the houses as what remains to speak after the people are gone.
accepted_findings.containment: The recurrence is an evidentiary image; it does not erase the ordinary meaning of dwellings.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: F002: plural fixed sites and locations
branch_contributions.independent_anchor: The source phrase makes the surviving dwelling sites the medium of clarity
branch_contributions.contribution: The settled locations remain as fixed witnesses after their occupants vanish.
branch_contributions.boundary: No special place-name or bodily-location use is imported.

accepted_findings.title: resumptive conjunction returns to causal narration
accepted_findings.claim: The conjunction after the evidence parenthesis reconnects the ayah to the downfall mechanism.
accepted_findings.mechanism: وَ separates the inserted proof-frame from the following verbal clause while preserving narrative continuity.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The proof aside feels like a pause inside one causal movement, not a detached historical note.
accepted_findings.containment: A local discourse and attachment finding; no broader discourse theory is required.

accepted_findings.title: active verb separates agent, recipients, and object
accepted_findings.claim: The active beautification clause keeps agent, affected recipients, and beautified object grammatically visible.
accepted_findings.mechanism: زَيَّنَ is active Form II with الشَّيْطَانُ as subject, لَهُمُ as recipient phrase, and أَعْمَالَهُمْ as direct object.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The wording does not hide who acts, who is affected, or what is being made attractive.
accepted_findings.containment: Valency and role separation only; no extra psychological agency is inferred from the syntax.

accepted_findings.title: Form II turns moral judgment into worked-over surface
accepted_findings.claim: Form II makes the deeds an actively worked-over moral surface rather than merely a set of deeds that happens to look good.
accepted_findings.mechanism: The intensive active form of زَيَّنَ selects beautification applied to the explicit object أَعْمَالَهُمْ.
accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The downfall begins through attractive presentation before it appears as brute obstruction.
accepted_findings.containment: Active beautification is retained; the noun is not claimed to mean ornament itself.

branch_contributions.boundary: Natural vegetation and celestial adornment are excluded.

accepted_findings.title: beautification formula leads into path obstruction
accepted_findings.claim: The local beautification clause realizes a recurring mechanism in which attractive deeds lead into being turned from the way.

accepted_findings.reader_payoff: The reader notices a sequence from altered appearance to blocked movement.
accepted_findings.containment: Formulaic recurrence supports the mechanism but does not make every recurrence identical to this ayah.

accepted_findings.containment: Referential continuity only; no independent collective psychology is added.

accepted_findings.containment: Plural possession is local; it does not imply that every deed is identical or equally culpable.

branch_contributions.distinctive_facet: F001: owned action or practice

friction_notes.note: مِنْ مَسَاكِنِهِمْ is primarily a source phrase governed by the clarity event; the supplied nominative or modifying alternatives remain controlled secondary readings.
مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ supports a live bodily-sight versus inward-discernment range. Form X heightens the state but does not force maximal certainty.
The return pressure on عَادًا and depletion pressure on ثَمُودَا are contained background coloring, not free proper-name translations.
The sh-ṭ-n distance and directional-opposition contacts are exploratory and must not displace the definite adversarial-agent reading.
